🎓 How to Use the Positioning Strategy Skill

Use this skill in Joule to generate complete positioning and segmentation strategies.

💬

Trigger Phrases

  • "Build an ICP for..."
  • "Segment our market by..."
  • "Who should we target?"
  • "Define buyer personas for..."
📝

Sample Prompt

"Build an ICP for enterprise manufacturing companies adopting cloud ERP. Include firmographics, pain points, and buying committee roles."
📊

What You'll Get

  • Complete ICP — Firmographics, technographics, behavior
  • Persona Cards — Each buying committee role detailed
  • Messaging Hooks — Value props by persona
  • Qualification Criteria — Lead scoring inputs
💡

Pro Tips

  • Be specific — "Cloud ERP" not just "software"
  • Include context — Your product's strengths
  • Ask for competitors — Who else targets this segment?
